name: GD Send Logger
description: Detects successful Geometry Dash moderator sends and reports them to the configured Discord bot bridge.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Send successful moderator sends to the Discord bot bridge.

api-url.name: Bot API URL
api-url.description: Copy the API URL shown by /send-config -> Connection info.

connection-key.name: Connection Key
connection-key.description: Copy the server connection key shown by /send-config -> Connection info.

discord-user-id.name: Discord User ID
discord-user-id.description: Your numeric Discord user ID. The bot uses this for the Moderator mention.

debug-logging.name: Debug Logging
debug-logging.description: Log raw send values and bot responses to the Geode log.
